text: Figure 5.23: Transport Layer Overview Examples in chapter 5.15.6 and chapter 5.15.7 illustrate the usage of the TP model. In a normal case the PDU-routing is only supported for IPdus. In case of a gateway every incoming NPdus needs to be: • forwarded to corresponding inbound TP module and transformed into an IPdu • the IPdu needs to be forwarded to the PduR • the PduR routes the IPdu to the outgoing TP module • the outbound TP module transforms the IPdu into a NPdu which is then sent on the target bus. Especially the transformations in the TP modules take a signiﬁcant amount of time and resources. The behavior can be optimized when the source and the target network are of the same kind (e.g. Can-to-Can routing).
